<thought>Search the template catalog using valid functional group names: break a ketone (C=O) and a C‑C double bond, form an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring, and create C‑C and C‑O bonds while reducing the order of the C=C and C=O bonds.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2->1)", "C=O (2->1)"],
    "limit": 5
}
